name: Sarcopterygii
blurb: Coelacanths, lungfishes and the tetrapods: fins (or limbs) built on a single bone joined to the body.

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (PhyloBayes, CAT-GTR), calibration scheme C16; mean and conservative 95% credibility interval (extremes of the 95% CIs of 100 gene-jackknife timetrees)
clock.checked: Irisarri et al. 2017, Supplementary Table 9, node 103 ("Sarcopterygians (Sarcopterygii)")
